operations.label: Normalize each unknown analyte by UV
operations.description: Measure initial absorbance at 281.5 nm and dilute a separate aliquot until A281.5=2.6. Exact dilution and mixing aliquots unreported. quality.review_scope: Scoped review covers all 8 main-paper pages and all 10 matching SI pages; exact correction acceptance is required before integration.
missing_fields: No imported procedure from cited reference 40 or any external source.

No measured core-size distribution, crystal phase, atomic coordinates or experimental ligand-binding geometry reported. SI 3.4 nm is an author absorption-based estimate using a spherical assumption, not a TEM or DLS core measurement.

Unreported gas flow, sulfuric-acid injection volume, numeric reflux temperature, vessel geometry, routine bulk purification and storage remain missing. SI centrifugation/15 %HNO3 applies only to NAC ICP-AES sample preparation.
Plot ordinates are not digitized. All 360 numerical training-matrix values from SI Tables S3-S5 are retained as analytical replicates, not independent synthesis batches.
Physical batch/aliquot equivalence between synthesis, TEM, DLS, optical and ICP specimens is unreported. Product joins express source-named class/context only.

Main 189 ligands/QD versus SI 193 S/QD, first absorption570-575 nm versus SI~578 nm, DMAE hydrochloride identity versus Materials omission, and source0.5 mmol versus0.5 mM wording remain explicit conflicts.
The modified rare/UV-normalized assay section does not assign an independent NaOH-stock aliquot or concentration; no such reagent role is inferred here.
conflicts: ligand coverage: Main p.5:189 ligands/QD on average / SI p.7:193 S/QD calculated for purified NAC-QDs. Unresolved; preserve source-specific quantities, no averaging or transfer to each ligand.
first absorption peak: Main p.4:570-575 nm across four QDs / SI p.7: around 578 nm used in size estimate. Preserve distinct contexts; not an exact per-batch calibration.

DMAE identity: Main Figure 1C and p.2:2-dimethylaminoethanethiol hydrochloride / Materials p.2:2-dimethylaminethanethiol,95 %, without hydrochloride. Preserve hydrochloride explicitly shown in identity panel and flag Materials omission; no silent free-base substitution.

standard analyte concentration unit: Methods and Figure 5:0.5 mM / Main p.6 comparison paragraph:0.5 mmol. Use explicit Methods concentration in standard recipe; retain conflicting comparison wording.

NAC terminal group name: Source compound N-acetyl-L-cysteine and Figure 1C amide structure / Main body calls NAC terminal group formamide. Chemical identity stays N-acetyl-L-cysteine; body group wording retained as source wording, no formamide reagent inferred.
